fields.summary_ko.0: GF Securities analyst Evan Lee downwardly revised DELL's target price to $341 and maintained a Hold rating, with DELL down more than 45% from the year's high.
fields.summary_ko.1: Enterprise server shipments for FY 2027 are expected to decline 9%, and stock rebound is expected to be difficult due to weak PC shipments and loss of SpaceX VR200 orders.
